verdict.rationale: Quo markets a shared business number that a team can use together, and its docs refer to Quo inboxes whose message history can be pulled per number. That supports the core idea of texts landing in a team-shared inbox. Nothing documents shared-inbox texting in depth or shows which teammate replied to a message. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a shared SMS inbox for multiple teammates, per-message attribution of who replied, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic, or list all your inboxes to see which numbers are available.
Pull messages and call activity from any Quo inbox and ask for a summary.
